task_message:
Case M05: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 200x200x180 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished. 

**Summary of the segmentation (M05, myxoid soft-tissue tumor):**
- **Finding:** A large, multilobulated, strongly T2-hyperintense mass (with internal low-signal septations and a thin low-signal capsule) located deep in the limb adjacent to the bone, spanning ~9 cm craniocaudally.
- **Method:** Seeded the mass with three positive points on an axial slice through its widest part (v1, 140.8 mL), then ran a model refinement that tightened the boundary and removed 9.2 mL of over-inclusion (v2, 132.1 mL).
- **Verification:** Checked axial, coronal and sagittal slices at the mask centre and at both ends of each axis; a trial extension along a thin linear bright track inferiorly was rejected (it produced a runaway thin strip reaching the volume edge) and undone.
- **Rejected candidates:** All four automatic proposals (C1–C4) corresponded to rings of subcutaneous fat, muscle or thin dark fascial planes — not tumor — so none were accepted.
- **Result:** One connected component, 132.1 mL, extent axial 36–138, coronal 88–143, sagittal 51–123, with no lesion tissue visible beyond either end in any plane. Confidence: medium (a few tiny peripheral lobules and the thin inferior bright track remain uncertain).
